# Gradio apps (Hugging Face)

Build Gradio web UIs and demos in Python, from simple forms to chatbots.

- Source: https://github.com/huggingface/skills
- SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/huggingface/skills/main/skills/huggingface-gradio/SKILL.md
- Author: Hugging Face
- License: Apache-2.0
- Page: https://commandvault.ai/commands/gradio-apps-hugging-face-d0321991

Gives Claude working knowledge of Gradio for building Python web demos: core patterns, key component signatures, layouts, event listeners, chat interfaces and custom HTML components. It also shows how to call a running Gradio app from the command line. An examples file is included. Requires Python with the gradio package.

**Try asking:**
- "Build a Gradio demo for my image classifier"
- "Make a chatbot UI in Gradio that streams responses"
- "Add a file upload and a results table to this Gradio app"

**Source:** [huggingface/skills](https://github.com/huggingface/skills/tree/HEAD/skills/huggingface-gradio) · Apache-2.0 · by Hugging Face
